release.body:
## What's Changed
* Changes the compatability link in README.md to point to the correct page by @GitJitBit in https://github.com/KytyPS5/KytyPS5/pull/2279

## New Contributors
* @GitJitBit made their first contribution in https://github.com/KytyPS5/KytyPS5/pull/2279

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/KytyPS5/KytyPS5/compare/KytyPS5-2026-11-14-3e226bf...KytyPS5-2026-11-15-f9dd415

commit.message: graphics: render 4_4_4_4 targets as 5_5_5_1 on hosts that cannot render them
graphics: drop tessellation draws followed by a geometry shader
shader: emit point and line output primitives for NGG geometry shaders
shader: drive shared-stack BVH walks with ray queries
graphics: mirror BLAS-root pairs over the header's records without a walk
shader: drive BLAS walks nested under a TLAS walk with ray queries
